notes.title: Multi-Language Update! First Discount for Trilogy of the Moon

notes.title: New Language Pack Update for Trilogy of the Moon Completed
notes.notes:
Hello,
This is the Skyplus Team of Trilogy of the Moon.

Thanks to your continued support, we are pleased to announce that the new language pack update has been successfully completed.

This update adds the following three languages:
German (Deutsch)
Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
Thai (ภาษาไทย)

📌 Applicable Versions
Full Version
Demo Version

Now, more global users can enjoy Trilogy of the Moon in their preferred language.

Future language updates are planned, and we will inform you as soon as more information becomes available.

The Skyplus Team will continue to work hard to provide a richer gaming experience by expanding language support and improving content quality.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: 📢 April 15th Trilogy of the Moon Major Bug Fix Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Skyplus team.

Thank you for playing 《Trilogy of the Moon》.
We have identified some issues where certain features in the game were not functioning properly, and have applied the following patches:

🔧 Bug Fixes
1. Fixed the issue where the screen appears cut off at certain resolutions
2. Fixed the issue where the main screen background music volume could not be adjusted

We will continue to do our best to provide you with a comfortable playing environment.
If you have any inconveniences or suggestions while playing, please feel free to leave your feedback through the Steam discussion board.
We will listen to your feedback and strive to take prompt action.

Thank you.
From the Skyplus Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470356/4261a0e2efae6f0597ef718561cdecfcdaa58460.jpg

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470356/22c51754706e2e9b1efd39de8b242ad32dc9ce6a.jpg

Hello from the  team.

We would like to inform you about our game's release schedule. 

Although we had been preparing for a March release, 
the STEAM build review process has taken longer than expected, 
forcing us to adjust our release date to April.

Currently, our team is focusing all our efforts on passing the review as quickly as possible, 
aiming for an early April release. We sincerely apologize for not being able to meet with our eager gamers sooner than planned.

We are also preparing various special events for the release and will share more news as soon as the review is completed. 

Press "Wishlist" on the "Trilogy of the Moon" store page to receive the latest release updates first!

We are committed to resolving this delay promptly and providing you with the best gaming experience possible.

We deeply appreciate everyone who continues to support us and patiently wait for our game's release.

Trilogy of the Moon Team
